title: Demo farm fold accepts a demo whose pages redirect (multilingual `/` → `/en/`, `/contact` → `/contact/`)
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/demo-farm-baseline.test.mjs packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/demo-farm.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the result of each case whose name starts with 'baseline:', 'verify: a baseline line with an empty title' and 'heredocs: the pool and the farm compose render'.
expect: A `/` that redirects on its own host (absolute or relative Location) is kept as a redirect and its 200 landing page and links are baselined; a foreign host, userinfo, another local port, a loop, more than 3 hops or a non-200 landing page is refused.
A baseline line with an empty title (a redirect) verifies equal to the same answer; a changed Location differs.
Rendering the pool and the farm compose runs no command on the host (empty stderr) and keeps the comment text.

selectors.render: tracy_farm_render_pool and the farm compose in packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/scripts/lib/demo-farm.sh

evidence: 14/11/2026 dev host: fold.sh refused business-joomla ('does not answer / with 200 today (/ 301 …/en/)') and ja-essence-wordpress / ja-kinetic-wordpress ('/contact: was [301 …/contact/], now [301 …/contact/<TAB>]'); with this branch's scripts all three folded and answered at their public URLs.
fence: A redirect is followed only on the probe host or its own 127.0.0.1:<port>, at most 3 hops; every baseline line is compared byte for byte.

tests: baseline: `/` that is a 200 keeps its own links
baseline: `/` that redirects on its own host is kept as a redirect
baseline: a redirect to another host is refused
baseline: a redirect loop and more than 3 hops are refused
baseline: a landing page that is not a 200 is refused
baseline: a Location with userinfo, another hostname or another local port is refused
verify: a baseline line with an empty title (a redirect) verifies equal
heredocs: the pool and the farm compose render with no command run on the host
